pages.title: Growth Takes Real Time
pages.text: Babies no longer grow up automatically after a dozen minutes like in vanilla. They now need growth time measured in days.$(br2)A calf takes 7 MC days as the baseline, plus or minus 2 days, so 5~9 days in practice.$(br2)Smaller animals grow faster - chickens mature far quicker than cows, while huge animals take much longer.

pages.title: Only Well-Fed Babies Grow
pages.text: A baby only accumulates growth time while its hunger is at or above 50% of its maximum.$(br2)Growth stalls completely when it is hungry and only resumes once you feed it. Time lost while stalled is never made up, so feed them early.

pages.title: Checking Growth Progress
pages.text: With Jade installed, look at a baby to see its growth progress percentage. If it says "Too hungry, growth paused", it is time to feed it.$(br2)Babies also follow their own mother instead of any random adult of their kind - keep mother and child together.
Keep hay bales or wheat stocked in the pen so babies can always eat. They only take part in breeding once fully grown.
